column1: # Covers: steel and industry, satellites and media, banks/finance/insurance, airlines and transport,
# telecom and energy, retail, beer/wine/water/dairy, bakeries, tech startups, football clubs.
# Companies founded abroad but headquartered and built up in Luxembourg (Eurofins, Millicom, Aperam) are
# included; foreign groups' Luxembourg branches are not.
# Sources: Wikipedia "List of companies of Luxembourg", categories "Companies of Luxembourg by industry",
# "Food and drink / Breweries / Mass media / Manufacturing / Software companies of Luxembourg"; web search on
# Luxembourg brands (Made in Luxembourg label pages); own knowledge for the rest. Hangul: Korean news forms
# where they exist (아르셀로미탈, 카고룩스, 룩스에어), otherwise French/German/Luxembourgish 외래어 표기법.
